How We Help You Overcome Laravel Development Challenges

Finding Skilled Laravel Developers for Hire with the Right Expertise

With Laravel being a widely used framework, there’s an overwhelming number of candidates in the market with variable levels of experience and specialization. Filtering out the right fit for your project can be time-consuming and complex. Mobilunity streamlines this process by providing pre-vetted, proficient Laravel developers tailored to your specific needs.

Speeding Up the Hiring Process Without Compromising Quality

Traditional hiring methods can take weeks or even months, delaying development and increasing operational costs. Mobilunity offers a fast and efficient recruitment process, allowing businesses to hire dedicated Laravel programmers within just 4-6 weeks, ensuring a quicker project start and faster time-to-market.

Balancing Development Costs Without Compromising Quality

Hiring dedicated developers locally is considered more cost-effective. In reality, local talent shortages drive up costs, still potentially bearing quality concerns. Mobilunity’s flexible model secures cost-effective access to talented Laravel developers in strategic locations with competitive rates, high development standards, and seamless collaboration across time zones.

Ensuring Full Control Over Remote Teams

A common concern with onboarding Laravel developers remotely is losing control over the development process. Many outsourcing models limit direct interaction with the team. With Mobilunity, you have direct access to your remote Laravel developers, allowing you to manage them as part of your in-house team while we handle administrative tasks.

Retaining Laravel Talent for Long-Term Projects

High developer turnover is a major risk in the software development industry, leading to delays, knowledge loss, and increased hiring costs. Mobilunity’s 3R approach – Recruitment, Retention, and Relationship – ensures the engagement and commitment of your Laravel engineers for long-term stability.

Scaling Laravel Applications for Business Growth

As businesses expand, their applications encounter increasing traffic and complex integrations. Poor optimization can lead to slow load times, downtime, and lost revenue. When you hire expert Laravel developers from Mobilunity, you ensure your platform remains fast, scalable, and reliable with caching, load balancing, and cloud scaling.

Laravel Development Services By Specialists Provided by Mobilunity

Let your business find its truest potential when you hire best Laravel developers at Mobilunity. Our programmers are proficient in all Laravel specifics and can cover multiple project development needs.

Laravel Web Application Development

Laravel framework is a reliable technology for building secure, scalable, and high-performance web apps. It provides a structured architecture, an intuitive syntax, and built-in features that streamline development, making it an ideal choice for businesses looking to create custom digital solutions.

Laravel Enterprise Solutions

Enterprise applications require stability, scalability, and security. Laravel offers a powerful ecosystem for developing complex enterprise solutions that enhance operational efficiency, automate workflows, and provide seamless integration with existing systems, ensuring long-term business success.

Laravel Headless Development

Headless development using the Laravel framework allows businesses to separate their backend logic from the front end, providing flexibility in choosing frontend technologies like React, Vue.js, or Angular. This strategy ensures faster performance, enhanced scalability, and an enriched user experience across multiple devices.

Laravel API & Module Development

Custom APIs and modules enhance application functionality by enabling seamless integration with third-party services, mobile applications, and internal business tools. Laravel’s built-in API capabilities and modular structure make it an excellent framework for developing scalable and secure API-driven applications.

Laravel Microservices Architecture

Laravel’s built-in tools and ecosystem simplify breaking down large, monolithic applications into smaller, independent elements, which makes the framework best suitable for microservices. This improves maintainability, speeds up deployments, and allows businesses to scale individual components as needed, enhancing overall system efficiency.

Laravel Cloud Services

Deploying applications on cloud platforms ensures flexibility, scalability, and enhanced performance. Laravel integrates flawlessly with such cloud providers as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Azure, offering automated scaling, load balancing, and secure data storage for businesses operating in active environments.

Laravel CRM Development

CRM systems built with Laravel enable businesses to streamline customer interactions, automate communication, and manage leads effectively. Laravel’s flexibility allows for highly customized CRM solutions adjusted to specific business needs, enhancing customer engagement and retention.

Laravel Extension Development

Custom Laravel extensions allow businesses to add unique functionalities to their applications without modifying the core framework. These extensions help enhance user experience, optimize workflows, and integrate specialized features that align with specific business objectives.

FAQs on Laravel Developers

How Much Does It Cost to Hire Remote Laravel Developers?

This depends on where you looking to hire Laravel developers from and their level of experience. Typically, when hiring from Eastern European countries, the cost of hiring a Laravel developer is lower compared to the rest of Europe and the United States. That’s why many companies choose offshore Laravel talent to boost their teams efficiently.

Do You Provide Assistance for the Laravel Developer Technical Interview?

Certainly, when you want to hire Laravel team but have no tech experience, we can offer support for the technical interview as a part of our specialized services. We organize interviews with premier professionals, suitable when your team does not have this expertise. We’ll also provide a detailed summary and expert feedback from the interview.

What Is the Timeline for Building a Laravel App?

The complexity of your app and how many features you want to include will determine this. Our expert team always follows a “first time right” coding methodology to ensure the delivery of the final product as fast as possible.

Do You Sign an SLA and NDA with Your Clients?

Yes, all our projects are strictly covered by Non-Disclosure Agreements, which will usually form part of the Service Level Agreement when it is signed before the start of operations.

Can you Migrate an Existing PHP App into a Laravel PHP Application?

When you choose Laravel for your development needs, we can assemble dedicated teams based on your requirements, so that they have exactly the right expertise to provide any API-related efforts for you.

What Are the Skills to Look for in PHP Laravel Developers?

Developers we select usually have a deep background in Laravel development and are greatly skilled in many related technologies like PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, Vue.js, Inertia.js, Livewire, Alpine.js, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, Git, Docker, Vuex, Pinia.

Can Your Coders Help Me Complete My Unfinished App Development Project?

Yes, we always provide a dedicated team of Laravel experts who are skilled enough and have experience in picking up projects halfway through. All we would need from you is details on what the previous team did and was supposed to do to ensure our expertise meets your initial and final project goals.

Do Your Developers Follow SEO-Friendly Practices to Make a Website Search Engine-Friendly?

Laravel programmers selected by Mobilunity always design sites and apps that are completely SEO-friendly. This includes full server-side rendering, implementing interactive and emerging UI/UX trends, using schema markups for all rich snippets, and, finally, crafting crawlable structures along with unique URLs.

Do You Provide Any Support and Maintenance Services after Deployment?

Yes, dedicated Laravel experts submitted by Mobilunity provide bug fixes, comprehensive framework upgrades, continuous monitoring, and any further technical glitch resolution for the complete improvement of your Laravel project.
